classes.name: Juggernaut
classes.flavourText:
What divides the conqueror 
 from the conquered? Perseverance.

classes.name: Berserker
classes.flavourText:
The savage path is 
always swift and sure.

classes.name: Chieftain
classes.flavourText:
The Ancestors speak 
through your clenched fists.

classes.name: Raider
classes.flavourText:
No hunt is complete without
the gutting and the skinning.

classes.name: Deadeye
classes.flavourText:
A woman can change the world 
with a single, well-placed arrow.

classes.name: Pathfinder
classes.flavourText:
There are venoms and virtues aplenty in 
 the wilds, if you know where to look.

classes.name: Occultist
classes.flavourText:
Throw off the chains
of fear and embrace that
 which was forbidden.

classes.name: Elementalist
classes.flavourText:
Feed a storm with savage intent 
and not even the strongest walls
will hold it back.

classes.name: Necromancer
classes.flavourText:
Embrace the serene
power that is undeath.

classes.name: Slayer
classes.flavourText:
No judge. No jury.
Just the executioner.

classes.name: Gladiator
classes.flavourText:
Raise your hand to the 
roaring crowd and pledge 
your allegiance to glory.

classes.name: Champion
classes.flavourText:
Champion that which 
 you love. He who fights
 for nothing, dies
 for nothing.

classes.name: Inquisitor
classes.flavourText:
Truth is elusive, yet God has
provided us with all the tools 
 necessary to find it.

classes.name: Hierophant
classes.flavourText:
Drink deeply from God's
 chalice, for the faithful
 will never find it empty.

classes.name: Guardian
classes.flavourText:
When bound by faith
 and respect, the flock
 will overwhelm the wolf.

classes.name: Assassin
classes.flavourText:
Death is a banquet. 
 It's up to the murderer 
 to write the menu.

classes.name: Trickster
classes.flavourText:
Everyone knows how to die. 
 Some just need a little nudge 
to get them started.

classes.name: Saboteur
classes.flavourText:
The artist need not be present 
 to make a lasting impression.
